## Findings
- claim-1: The later-paper candidate is Avery St. Dizier–Alexander Yong, *Presenting the cohomology of a Schubert variety: Proof of the minimality conjecture*, DOI \(10.1112/jlms.12832\); its abstract states that it proves the minimality conjecture using the Hopf-algebra structure of symmetric functions. [doi:10.1112/jlms.12832]
- claim-2: The supplied exact text defines the earlier paper’s \(J_v\) by \(J_v:=\Bbbk\text{-span}\{\sigma_u:u\ge v\}\). [source-2@L328-L337|claim=formal-document]
- claim-3: The earlier paper introduces \(\Bbbk\) as a field of characteristic zero in its Borel-presentation setup. [source-2@L125-L139|claim=formal-document]
- claim-4: No indexed full-text passage from the later paper is supplied; therefore its exact definitions, theorem number(s), coefficient ring, and the precise map relating its \(J_v\) to \(\Lambda/I_{r,n-r}\) cannot be recorded.
- claim-5: The DOI abstract alone does not establish an integral Schur-span description of \(J_v\), an integral box-algebra identification, or hypotheses under which such an identification holds.
## Strategy
Use only the supplied DOI/arXiv metadata, abstract, and indexed earlier-paper excerpts. Treat the later paper as an identified but theorem-text-unretrieved lead; do not transfer definitions, coefficient hypotheses, or maps from the 2011 paper.

## Gaps
No indexed later-paper full-text excerpt is supplied. Therefore its definition of \(J_v\), theorem locator and hypotheses, coefficient ring, integral box algebra, and comparison-map formula/direction remain unresolved. The DOI abstract proves none of these items.

## Next
Obtain indexed primary-text passages from DOI \(10.1112/jlms.12832\) containing the requested definition, theorem, coefficient assumptions, box-algebra presentation, and comparison map. Until then, retain this as a bounded unsuccessful theorem-level retrieval attempt.
